movelist.name: Stone Axe
movelist.effect: Stone Axe is a critical hit on an 18+. Once per scene, on a hit, the target may be put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Swords Dance
movelist.effect: The user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Air Slash
movelist.effect: Air Slash Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Stealth Rock
movelist.effect: Set 4 square meters of Stealth Rock hazards within 6 meters. If a foe moves within 2 meters of a space occupied by Rocks, move at most one Rock to the offender, then destroy the Rock. When that happens, the Stealth Rock causes a foe to lose a Tick of Hit Points. Stealth Rock is considered to be dealing damage; Apply Weakness and Resistance. Do not apply stats. A Pokémon who has been hit by a Stealth Rock Hazard cannot get hit by another in the same encounter until it is returned to a Poké Ball and then sent back out.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.effect: The user ignores the effect of enemies’ Defensive Abilities.
